acceptanceCriteria: example-join maps absolute digest keys to repository-relative paths, and an ambiguous key gets a typed refusal, with tests.
body: Residual from V1-2039/V1-2040 (PR #1317, TSA-V0-410..419). JS receipts key TestFileDigests by absolute path, so a test file outside the repository root, or a digest key matching more than one anchor file, abstains `example-identity-unbound`. Expected: these still join, or a typed refusal names the cause.
title: JS example-join abstains example-identity-unbound when receipt TestFileDigests keys are absolute or ambiguous
